items.title: Resurgent in April, can bulls defy 'Sell in May' maxim?
items.description: Indian stock markets may see continued gains in May. Investors should resist the urge to sell. While a repeat of April's strong rally is unlikely, key indices have historically performed well in May. Moderate, stock-specific moves are expected. Elevated oil prices and a strong dollar could limit significant upside.

items.title: Stock Radar: Down over 20% from highs! Jio Financial Services stock showing signs of bottoming out
items.description: Jio Financial Services has established a strong base above 220 and broken out of a two-month inverse head-and-shoulders pattern, signaling building bullish momentum. Experts suggest short-term traders with a high-risk profile can buy for a target of Rs 280 in the coming weeks.

items.title: Tax shadow over charitable trusts with 'profit' motive
items.description: Three top-notch hospitals in Mumbai and a famous international spiritual organisation-all functioning as charitable trusts-have been denied Income tax (I-T) exemption on the grounds that they were carrying out commercial activities.
